label: T54W IP phone
description: Yealink SIP-T54W prime business desk phone with a 4.3-inch adjustable colour display, 16 SIP accounts and built-in dual-band Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth, sitting on a dual-port Gigabit Ethernet switch whose second RJ45 is a PC passthrough. Powered by 802.3af PoE class 3 or an optional 5 V adapter.
notes: Interface section: dual-port Gigabit Ethernet, PoE IEEE 802.3af class 3, 1x RJ9 handset + 1x RJ9 headset (neither modelled). PoE draw 2.2-5.5 W, so the class-3 reservation is what the PSE must budget, not the measured draw. Built-in Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac 2.4/5 GHz (433 Mbps) and Bluetooth 4.2; DECT only via the DD10K dongle, so the phone acts as a Wi-Fi or wired endpoint but not a DECT base. VLAN via 802.1p/Q, LLDP/CDP/DHCP-VLAN, 802.1X, OpenVPN, TR-069. The USB 2.0 port is not modelled.
